settings.aboutText:
Woodwork is the starting point for your furniture brand. Replace this introduction with your own story: the people behind the pieces, the materials you choose, and what makes your approach special.

This sample collection explores simple silhouettes, natural wood textures, and thoughtful details for everyday spaces. Every photograph, specification, and price shown here is illustrative.

Tell visitors how you work, where they can see your collection, and how to discuss a piece with your team. You can update this entire page in Site Content in the admin editor.

products.name: Forma Coffee Table
products.description: A sculptural oval silhouette, grounded by two rounded pedestals. Expressive walnut grain brings a natural warmth to the center of your living space.

images.alt: Forma oval walnut coffee table with two pedestal legs

products.name: Arc Side Table
products.description: A small companion with a generous presence. A circular oak top and three simple legs make room for a book, a cup, or a favorite object.

products.name: Line Media Unit
products.description: A calm horizontal line for your living room. Flush walnut doors keep everyday essentials close while a slim metal base gives the form a lighter feel.

images.alt: Line walnut media console on slim black legs

products.name: Gather Dining Table
products.description: A place for unhurried meals and everyday conversation. Soft corners meet a sculptural trestle base in a dining table with a welcoming natural oak finish.

images.alt: Gather oak dining table with trestle base

products.name: Curve Dining Chair
products.description: A curved timber backrest and a soft sage seat bring a little ease to the dining table. Slender walnut legs keep the profile open and light.

images.alt: Curve walnut dining chair with sage green seat

products.name: Rest Oak Bed
products.description: A low, understated frame for a slower end to the day. Natural oak and a simple timber headboard give the bedroom a sense of quiet continuity.

images.alt: Rest low oak bed frame with white linen

products.name: Grain Bowl Set
products.description: Two turned walnut bowls that celebrate the material in its simplest form. Display them together or use them to hold the small things that make a room yours.

images.alt: Grain set of two sculptural walnut bowls
